items.summary: Indigenous farmer Banu Ismahasan walks through a golden field of tall stalks in southeastern Taiwan, harvesting by hand the grain heads of an ancient crop resistant to extreme weather.

items.title: Nations grapple with loss of 1.5C target at UN climate summit
items.summary: For a decade, the 1.5C goal has served as the north star of climate action, a line nations pledged to hold to avoid the worst ravages of a warming planet.

items.title: SpaceX's Starship returns from orbit and is captured by launch pad arms in a dramatic first
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship made a triumphant return to Earth on Saturday, caught in midair by giant mechanical arms where its journey began 22 hours earlier.

items.title: ALMA reveals three star-forming cores at different stages inside one gas clump
items.summary: Astronomers have revealed three dense cores at different evolutionary stages within the massive star-forming region G40.282−0.219, shedding light on the physical and chemical differences among cores within the same massive dense clump.

items.title: Is this iconic black hole image accurate? New study delivers an independent result
